name: Glastonbury Festival 2027
job: Help festivalgoers distinguish sold-out original sales from a possible spring resale and model the published general-admission deposit and per-order balance without implying an available ticket.
facets: Original sale versus potential spring resale
Registered ticket holders and child age boundary
Deposit, balance and one-order postage arithmetic
Private stage itinerary conflicts and transfer buffer
source_notes: Organiser lists general admission 23–27 June 2027 and reports tickets sold out, with returned-ticket resale in spring 2027. Published original GA price is £408 including booking fee, £100 deposit and £308 balance plus £11.25 per order of up to six. Resale terms and stock may differ and remain unverified.
